title: Bettina Umstead
description: Voted for LGBTQIA and Gender Support policy that allows school employees to keep secrets from parents about gender transitioning of their children at school.
body:
# Bettina Umstead

# Board of Education Chair

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/umstead-profile.png)

- Worked for the Equity Collaborative, an organization that promoted Critical Race Theory and trained teachers in school districts across the nation. She worked as an “**[equity leadership coach](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bettina-umstead/)**.”
- After President Trump was elected, she wrote in a **[post on LinkedIn](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/6a2b2684-a75e-4510-8ae5-4d90daa853b4/NC-Durham-Umstead-Linkedin.png)**: “I woke up thinking about how our educators will need to hold space for students and staff to process what has happened and what’s to come.”
- Issued a **[public statement](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/6f9aa574-2b3c-4b1f-88d2-cc363dc6dd8d/NC-Durham-Umstead-public-statement.png)** about Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Said she was “deeply troubled” by the increase in immigration enforcement around the Durham community.
- **[Voted](https://www.wral.com/story/durham-parents-discuss-need-for-and-against-lgbtq-protections/20620509/)** for **[LGBTQIA and Gender Support policy](https://go.boarddocs.com/nc/dpsnc/Board.nsf/goto?open&id=CLXMPG5A4FA0)** that allows school employees to keep secrets from parents about gender transitioning of their children at school.
- Recognized March 31, 2025 **[to be celebrated](https://citizenportal.ai/articles/6102641/North-Carolina/Durham-board-unanimously-recognizes-March-31-as-Transgender-Day-of-Visibility?ss=&af=-14087&source=ballotpedia)** in Durham Public Schools as “Transgender Day of Visibility.”
